role: Targeted official scientific terminology verification, not curriculum mapping or approval. The original author science predates the last GBS terminology cross-check.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: solubility product
sources.usedFor: Ion activities with stoichiometric powers; supports the distinction from raw total concentrations.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: standard hydrogen electrode
sources.usedFor: The hydrogen reference convention; no assertion of absolute zero potential.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: autocatalytic reaction
sources.usedFor: Product or intermediate involvement in catalysis; an increasing rate is possible but curve shape alone is not a unique proof.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: catalyst
sources.usedFor: Catalysis changes rates without changing the overall standard Gibbs-energy difference; phase relationships distinguish homogeneous and heterogeneous routes.

sources.title: IUPAC didactic resource: temperature and equilibrium
sources.usedFor: Temperature changes equilibrium constants; the author calculations explicitly state Kelvin and constant-enthalpy approximation.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: mechanism of a reaction
sources.usedFor: Alternative mechanisms may remain consistent with the available evidence.

sources.title: IUPAC Gold Book: rate-controlling step
sources.usedFor: GBS concerns rate control in composite reactions. Case12b uses a standard steady-state model with a return/capture competition; the coefficients and numerical data are own teaching choices.

limitations: No web source is promoted to an official Bundesland curriculum duty. Some direct Gold Book page opens returned internal errors; indexed official definitions/PDF/plain-text results and the cited IUPAC teaching page were used. No entire external document is copied.
